Tender Notice
Tuesday, 04 October 2016
7283 Hits
The Head of the Dept. of Biochemistry, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, and Sevagram invites sealed tenders for the consumable items listed in the enclosed/attached tender document. The tenders in sealed envelope superscribed with “Tenders for consumables under DBT Project in the Department of Biochemistry’ should be submitted to the “Head of the Department, Dept. of Biochemistry, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram, Maharashtra 442102” latest by
20/10/2016
up to 1.00 PM.
Tender forms can be obtained by sending email to ‘
centralstore@mgims.ac.in
’ or can be downloaded from the institute website (www.mgims.ac.in).
The Purchase Committee reserves the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason.
Biochemistry Department - DBT Project :
1) Biochemistry & Immunology Reagents & Centrifugal Filters

Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
